def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    c = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]

    # A[b][j] = cost at j if target is alternating pattern starting with b
    A = [[0] * n, [0] * n]
    for b in range(2):
        arr = A[b]
        for j in range(n):
            p = b ^ (j & 1)
            if int(s[j]) != p:
                arr[j] = c[j]

    # pre[b][k] = sum A[b][0..k-1]
    pre = [[0] * (n + 1), [0] * (n + 1)]
    for b in range(2):
        for j in range(n):
            pre[b][j + 1] = pre[b][j] + A[b][j]

    # suf[b][k] = sum A[b][k..n-1]
    suf = [[0] * (n + 1), [0] * (n + 1)]
    for b in range(2):
        for j in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            suf[b][j] = suf[b][j + 1] + A[b][j]

    best = None
    for b in range(2):
        for i in range(n - 1):
            # prefix 0..i uses b, suffix i+1..n-1 uses 1-b
            cost = pre[b][i + 1] + suf[1 - b][i + 1]
            if best is None or cost < best:
                best = cost

    print(best)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    c = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + n]]

    # w[k][j]: cost to make position j match phase-k alternating pattern
    w = [[0] * n, [0] * n]
    for j in range(n):
        bit = ord(s[j]) - 48
        for k in (0, 1):
            target = k ^ (j & 1)
            w[k][j] = c[j] if bit != target else 0

    # prefix sums
    P = [[0] * n, [0] * n]
    for k in (0, 1):
        acc = 0
        for j in range(n):
            acc += w[k][j]
            P[k][j] = acc
    W = [P[0][n - 1], P[1][n - 1]]

    best = None
    for b in (0, 1):
        o = 1 - b
        for i in range(n - 1):
            cost = P[b][i] + (W[o] - P[o][i])
            if best is None or cost < best:
                best = cost

    print(best)
